subject.title: fix(control-ui): tighten About build grid spacing

question: After refreshing the merge result against current `main`, does the protected About-layout polish still match the intended Control UI spacing and merit landing?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proof-positive, but the protected `maintainer` label and behind-base state require an explicit maintainer decision on the exact merge result.

options.title: Refresh and merge
